name: hermes-tripo-desktop
description: Tripo 3D viewer for Hermes Desktop: inline transcript cards with Next and Download menus, a Tripo 3D gallery and a credit chip, rendered with three.js.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.tsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --jsx=automatic --minify --legal-comments=eof --external:@hermes/plugin-sdk --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --outfile=desktop/plugin.js && esbuild src/play.ts --format=esm --banner:js="// Built from the Tripo Hermes plugin's src/play.ts (npm run build)." --outfile=skills/tripo-game-asset/assets/playable-web/play.js
